hosted_verification.historical_premerge_master_gate: At the exact-head observation, FND-SONAR-0002 was the independently tracked master Sonar gate condition. It was later separately user-bounded for PR #42 delivery and is not a dependency of this verified source repair.

summary: Framework PR #42 exact head 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457 failed its required python-ci-security-quality check in GitHub Actions run 29942429850 with five Pyright type diagnostics. Candidate commit 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 narrowed the dynamic values and corrected the fixture annotation. Its bounded local validation and fresh hosted python-ci-security-quality/Pyright run 29943112344/job 89001693819 passed; all non-skipped PR checks and the PR Sonar Quality Gate are green. PR #42 then merged normally as resulting Framework master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8, whose CI security Python quality workflow 29989195066 and seven other exact-master GitHub Actions workflows completed success. The source remediation is verified, not closed. FND-SONAR-0002 and FND-GITHUB-0007 are separate bounded delivery limitations, not blockers of this repair.
summary_de: Der exakte Head 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457 von Framework-PR #42 scheiterte im erforderlichen Check python-ci-security-quality des GitHub-Actions-Runs 29942429850 mit fünf Pyright-Typdiagnosen. Der Kandidaten-Commit 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 grenzte die dynamischen Werte ein und korrigierte die Fixture-Annotation. Seine begrenzte lokale Validierung und der frische gehostete python-ci-security-quality/Pyright-Run 29943112344/Job 89001693819 bestanden; alle nicht übersprungenen PR-Checks und das PR-Sonar-Quality-Gate sind grün. PR #42 wurde danach normal als resultierender Framework-Master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 integriert; dessen CI-security-Python-quality-Workflow 29989195066 und sieben weitere exakte Master-GitHub-Actions-Workflows endeten erfolgreich. Die Source-Remediation ist verified, nicht closed. FND-SONAR-0002 und FND-GITHUB-0007 sind getrennte begrenzte Delivery-Limitierungen, keine Blocker dieser Reparatur.
technical_claim: This is a reproducible required CI-quality failure on the recorded hosted head. It is not evidence of a runtime defect or a validated vulnerability. The affected helper participates in a security-quality/provenance workflow, so the remediation must preserve its existing download-host, release-identity, action-lock, permission, publisher, checkout, and ref-validation controls.
entry_point: Framework PR #42 invokes the hosted python-ci-security-quality job, which reaches deterministic Pyright analysis for the CI security-quality source and tests.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: Static typing sees repeated dynamic mapping lookups as Any | None at re.fullmatch call sites and an object-typed nested fixture value before indexing. No attacker-controlled source-to-sink path or broken runtime security control is established by the type diagnostics.
observed_behavior: GitHub Actions run 29942429850 fails python-ci-security-quality on exact PR #42 head 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457 during deterministic Pyright analysis with five errors. The hosted log identifies ci/tools/fetch-security-tool.py lines 161 and 166, where dict.get() values typed Any | None are supplied to re.fullmatch, and tests/ci_security/test_update_workflow_tools.py line 49, where a value typed object is indexed.
expected_behavior: The required Python-quality job must complete successfully without suppressing Pyright or weakening its scope. Dynamic mapping values must be narrowed before regular-expression matching, nested YAML-derived lock data must carry an accurate type contract before indexing, and the existing provenance and workflow-security behavior must remain unchanged.
impact: The original exact PR head could not satisfy a required CI gate and was a P1 release blocker. Candidate head 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 satisfies the direct Pyright gate and all non-skipped PR checks. PR #42 then merged normally as resulting Framework master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8, where CI security Python quality workflow 29989195066 and the other seven exact-master GitHub Actions workflows completed success. The source repair is verified and no longer a release blocker. The evidence does not claim changed runtime behavior, a security exploit, or a configuration defect; FND-SONAR-0002 and FND-GITHUB-0007 are separate bounded delivery limitations, not source-remediation blockers.
preconditions: Framework PR #42 is evaluated at exact head 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457.
GitHub Actions runs python-ci-security-quality and reaches the deterministic Pyright step.

reproduction: Inspect GitHub Actions run 29942429850 for Framework PR #42 at 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457; python-ci-security-quality terminates failed with five Pyright diagnostics.
The retained PR #42 Pyright follow-up receipt records the same failing head, run, check, locations, and the bounded local candidate remediation.
root_cause: The original source allowed repeated dynamic dict.get() results to retain the Any | None type at re.fullmatch boundaries, while the test lock fixture declared a flat object map despite the nested dynamic YAML-derived structure it is indexed as. The exact runtime behavior is not alleged to be wrong; the declared static type contracts were insufficient for the required Pyright analysis.
proposed_remediation: Use only the bounded candidate correction at 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 or an equivalently reviewed successor: store upstream_release and asset_url once, check and narrow their string type before matching, type the dynamic nested lock fixture as nested Any data, and preserve all existing provenance and workflow-security controls. Do not add a Pyright suppression, broaden the type checker exclusions, or alter download, lock, permission, publisher, checkout, or ref-validation behavior merely to obtain a pass.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed candidate retains the bounded narrowing and nested fixture typing without changing download host, release identity, action lock, workflow permissions, publisher, checkout, or ref-validation behavior.

Focused Fetcher/Updater tests, CI-security contract, documentation and Change Record contracts, checksum-verified Ruff check and format check for touched Python files, native make lint, clean-worktree review, and git diff --check pass for the candidate range.
